state: M1/M4/M6 selected (heads/selection.json); M3 cohort generating; prior diagnosis running; no M2/M3 outcome seen

m3.augmentation: meta-training = 720 sealed MDPs + 168-MDP behavior cohort (ratio_baseline, epsilon_star, random_mixture)
m3.procedure: refit every head of heads/ on the augmented panel; re-run the identical M1 x M4 grid and selection rules
adopt_if: external score of the re-selected v2 lower than without M3
SPIBB (rel IBS + rel LL)/2 lower than without M3
internal rel IBS and rel LL vs OEH current each <= +0.02
m3.also_report: OEH current refit on the augmented panel (does M3 alone help?)

m2.step0: prior_diagnosis: raw OEH-B law and per-budget success calibration under reward_prior exchangeable vs unseen_zero (same seeds)
m2.continue_if: exchangeable improves raw-law log loss by >= 5% relative on at least two of the three external panels without worsening the internal panel by > 5%; otherwise stop M2 and record the cause as open
m2.if_continued: Bayesian averaging over the two reward priors with weights from the pilot marginal likelihood requires re-running OEH-B on the whole meta panel; decided after step 0
